content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Article XIII (p0130) is a one-sided liability provision — only Licensor's liability is capped, and at one half of amounts paid (below the six-month walk-away floor), while our liability, including the broad Article XII indemnity (p0128), is uncapped with no carve-outs. No other cap or "aggregate liability" language exists elsewhere in the document (the Article VIX/warranty disclaimer paragraphs and General Provisions contain none).

**Classification:** deviation (walk-away territory), targeted at the fallback with two surgical operations:
1. Clause (b) recast as a mutual cap at fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the claim (untouched words preserved verbatim).
2. A single short carve-out sentence placing indemnification, confidentiality breach, gross negligence and willful misconduct outside the cap.

Clause (a)'s one-sided consequential-damages exclusion and clause (c) were left intact as outside the fallback checklist, and noted in the rationale for negotiation.
